note: Admin-only Architecture (Modules) workspace. The platform is a set of pluggable modules, not a rigid stack. This is the guide for what exists, what is being built, and what is planned: every feature added to the platform should slot into one of these modules. Each module has its own admin page (left rail navigates between them); the home page shows the overview of all modules. M1 carries a per-game sub-module store (searchable game dropdown) where each game's LOCKED build spec lives. Staff only.

overview.title: How the Platform Works
overview.subtitle: Living overview — keep updated when any module spec changes. The agent must read this before any feature work.

flowChain.label: Game emits result envelope on match finish
Seam fans envelope to local points subscriber
Seam fans envelope to global ledgers subscriber
Tier boost: kind-1 credit into M4b+M4c only (never M4a)
Signup/referral/giveaway: kind-1 credit into M4b+M4c only
Seam fans envelope to competitions subscriber

modules.title: Game core
modules.what: The games themselves (Ludo, Ayo Olopon, ...). On-chain ER VRF dice for every seat. Knows NOTHING about points, tiers, or competitions. Emits into M2 on match finish.

modules.title: Result seam
modules.what: The universal plug-and-play bus. One call per game finish (window.publishGameResult), one subscription for all consumers. Validates/normalizes the envelope, fans to M3/M4/M7.

modules.title: Local points
modules.what: Per-game two-track on-chain ledger: (1) LOCAL PURE — every verified win in that game, unspendable, never diluted, bragging-rights source of truth; (2) LOCAL SPENDABLE — the spendable split drawn down by that game's own in-game spends. Only the 'You' seat ever earns.

modules.title: Global ledgers
modules.what: Site-wide three ledgers: (a) PURE — sum of M3 local wins across all games, no multiplier, honest cross-game skill total; (b) LIFETIME — every point earned from any source (M3 + M5 multiplier + M6 sources), unspendable; (c) SPENDABLE — the same lifetime total but spendable. Also owns the on-chain inventory/asset wallet [gfgassets, player].

modules.title: Active Tier
modules.what: Monthly subscription bought from M4c spendable. 2x/3x/4x multiplier on base win points, applied as a SECOND kind-1 credit into M4b+M4c only (M4a pure is never multiplied).

modules.title: Point sources
modules.what: Signup bonus, referral, giveaway, social earn. All feed M4b+M4c as kind-1 credits. Never touch M3 local or M4a pure.

modules.title: Competitions
modules.what: Earn events (daily/weekly/monthly) + leaderboards. Consumes the seam (M2). Entry from M4c spendable. Deferred until M1-M4 stable.

modules.title: Sponsor escrow
modules.what: Optional on-chain escrow plugin for M7. Brand locks SOL before the event, 30/70 rake at settle. Deferred until M7 product build.

flowDiagram.label: Data flow — every arrow is the universal result seam (M2)
flowDiagram.path: M1 Game → M2 Seam → M3 Local Bank (per-game pure+spendable) → M4 Global Bank (site-wide pure+lifetime+spendable) → M5 Tier Boost (kind-1 to lifetime+spendable only) / M6 Sources (kind-1 to lifetime+spendable only)

keyRules: Every game ends by emitting into M2; no game knows about points, tiers, or competitions.
M3 local points are NEVER diluted: no multiplier, no purchase, no bonus, no giveaway, no referral.
Multiplier (M5) applies only at M4 flow-up as kind-1 credits; M4a pure is NEVER multiplied.
Source-tagged: every M4 credit carries its game/event source ('Ludo', 'signup_bonus', 'tier2_boost').
Modules integrate through seams (M2), never hard-wires.
Build order gates everything: M1+M2+M3+M4 stable for Ludo FIRST → M5 → M6 → M7/M8. Never build ahead of the module status.

modules.title: Game core + proof of play
modules.summary: Per-game engine + on-chain ER VRF dice + verifiable roll. Knows NOTHING about points, tiers, competitions. M1 is ONE module; its game core sub-module M1A covers every game (Ludo locked now, Ayo Olopon planned next, then 50+) - the dropdown on this page differentiates the games. Each game's LOCKED spec lives there.
details: M1A = the game core sub-module for ALL games (one sub-module, many games). The dropdown below differentiates them: M1A Ludo (locked), M1A Ayo Olopon (planned), more later.
Ludo is the first M1A game (live, on-chain ER VRF dice for EVERY seat). LOCKED 2026-08-15.
ALL rolls resolve on-chain in the game's single delegated ER session (ER VRF queue, gasless, ~50-100ms), bundled with game moves - NO server-side /api/roll house roll in the on-chain build.

Three seat types: 'You' (signed-in user, own delegated dice PDA, session key, manual input); 'Human' (extra local human, on-chain roll like a computer, manual input, no separate session sign-in); 'Computer' (fully automated on-chain, automation itself runs in the ER).
Any seat's roll has NO offline fallback: retry x3 then pause + monitor (never fake roll).
A game emits into the universal result seam (M2) and knows nothing else. It NEVER knows how points/competitions work.
Pluggable: M1A Ayo Olopon becomes the next game with the same proof-of-play contract + the same result seam.
Per-game locked specs: see the game dropdown below (M1A Ludo locked 2026-08-15).

PROOF OF PLAY (verifiable tooling, shipped 2026-08-16): the public /verify/ receipt explorer proves any GlobalFolkGames receipt on-chain, because ER receipts are NOT indexed by public explorers (SolanaFM/Solana only see base + settlement). Signature lookups query BOTH the ER RPC (getTransaction on devnet-us.magicblock.app) and the base devnet RPC (api.devnet.solana.com); account lookups always surface the permanent base-explorer (solana.fm) record plus recent rollup sigs (getSignaturesForAddress). The ludo-lab winners popup gains a 'See on-chain receipt' link opening /verify/?tx=<sig> pre-filled + auto-queried. Honesty rule kept: never link an ER sig on a standard explorer. Lives as M1 game-tooling (game-adjacent), NOT inside public/universal/ - it is proof-of-play support for M1 games, not a universal consumer module.

games.title: Ludo
games.summary: LOCKED build spec for M1A (Ludo). The agent MUST read this before/during any Ludo M1 build, test against it, and only conclude M1 for Ludo when the build matches it end to end.
details: DICE - ER VRF for every seat, on-chain: every roll resolves on the MagicBlock ER VRF queue (5hBR...K5Tc, gasless, ~50-100ms). 'You' rolls via the player's own delegated dice PDA (session key signs, 0 SOL). Computer/human seats roll via the server-signed house roll (AMENDED 2026-08-15, owner-approved anti-cheat decision): the app-held sponsor key signs gasless ER VRF rolls on the same queue - the key never leaves the server, so a player can NEVER re-roll the computer's dice until favorable. A client-signed computer roll is impossible to make cheat-resistant on the current ER model (roll and its consumption are separate txs), so the house signer stays server-side. Full on-chain roll+move bundling (Match PDA, auto_computer_move) is a mainnet-phase build.

SEAT TYPES: (1) 'You' = signed-in user seat; roll via the player's own delegated dice PDA, session key signs silently (0 SOL); manual input (tap dice, tap token). (2) 'Human' = extra local human seat (dropdown 'Human', NOT 'You'); roll is ON-CHAIN via the server-signed house roll (sponsored by the app session; NO separate sign-in, NO session key requested); move is MANUAL input by the real human (dice tap + token tap), never auto-played. (3) 'Computer' = fully automated; roll on-chain via the server-signed house roll (AMENDED 2026-08-15: AI decision + token move are client-side in this build, the dice roll is the on-chain proof; auto_computer_move-style on-chain automation is deferred to mainnet and needs a Match PDA). Human-vs-computer timing constants unchanged (deliberate slow AI pace).

MATCH OUTCOMES (AMENDED 2026-08-16): finished = all active seats have all 4 tokens DISAPPEARED OFF THE BOARD COMPLETELY -> game marks status=finished (game state + persisted payload) and emits the seam. The FULL finish order 1st..Nth + reward mirror are committed on-chain by the Scope C consumer (record_result, gasless ER write, proof-bound to the match's proof-roll signature), now WIRED IN-GAME (2026-08-16): win-detection fires it soft-fail on match end and the ceremony shows a copyable receipt plus a working devnet link to the result account's base-layer creation tx when freshly sponsored. M1 still does NO reward banking itself (record_points is a separate mirror the legacy ludo build uses). ONLY finished earns M3/M4 rewards later (rewards gate on status===finished). A dedicated on-chain status field awaits the mainnet-phase Match PDA build. abandoned = End Match button (best-effort on tab close) closes the match in game state as status=abandoned - never rewarded, never emits the seam (this build keeps it client-side + persisted; the on-chain immortalized-abandoned record is mainnet-phase). session lost = browser dies with no tx -> ER session expires -> no permanent record (acceptable).
COMPLETED DEFINITION (confirmed): all active seats must finish. 2P: both seats all 4 tokens home. 4P: all 4 seats. No 'leader wins and match ends' shortcut - rewards stay honest.

ENDGAME BEHAVIOR: (1) auto-skip finished seats - once a seat has all 4 tokens off the board its turns auto-pass (~1.5s log, no dice roll, no tap) for human AND computer seats. (2) auto-complete - when all active seats have all 4 tokens off the board the loop STOPS (result ceremony 1st..4th + 'Play Again'), no infinite cycling, no reset-only ending. (3) NO skip-remaining toggle; End Match is the only speed escape hatch.

PÈ (capture) is UNCONDITIONAL on the common path - fixed + verified (commit 1af91cc, 18/18 checks, both ludo + ludo-lab). Only two safe zones: the 4 colored start boxes (universally safe for any token standing there) and the own-color home lane. Same-color tokens stack. Landing on an opponent with the LAST movable token + LAST die still pè's.

TERMINOLOGY (hard rules): 'disappeared from board completely' = the winning/finished state (stepsWalked >= 57, token at center, hidden) - this is what counts toward finishing. 'locked back in homebox / return home' = the LOSING state after pè (pathIndex -1, needs a 6 to re-enter). 'home safe zone' = the 5 colored boxes before the center (own color only). Two win paths: (a) full 360° circuit into own home lane -> center -> disappear; (b) pè fast-track - capture an opponent -> capturer completes circuit and disappears.
SEAM: M1 emits the gfg:game-result@1 envelope via window.publishGameResult when the match completes (all active seats finished). M1 knows NOTHING about points/tiers/competitions.

MATCH MODE (2P / 4P, pre-lock selector): selectable before the match locks via the Players toggle (2 or 4) on the setup panel. 2P plays the classic opposite corners (green + red) only - yellow + blue dropdowns are disabled - and the match completes when BOTH active seats have all 4 tokens home. 4P plays all four seats and completes when ALL FOUR finish. Everything derives from the ACTIVE seats: turn loop, endgame auto-complete, ceremony, and the seam envelope (2 players in 2P, 4 in 4P). matchMode is persisted and restored with the match. Changing mode mid-match is blocked once the match locks.

LOCAL POINTS (M3 cross-ref, owner-locked 2026-08-16): Ludo's own local scoring = 4P 1st 100 / 2nd 50 / 3rd 10 / 4th 0 (game auto-ends once 3 winners emerge, so 4th earns nothing); 2P only 1st earns 100 (2P auto-ends the moment 1st emerges). ONLY the 'You' (user) seat earns - house and local-human seats earn nothing even if first. Banked by the M3 universal module (public/universal/points/) via the seam; the game itself does NOT compute or bank points (M1 stays reward-blind).

games.title: Ayo Olopon
games.summary: Nigeria-native Ayo Olopon, the next M1A game. Spec not yet locked; when it is, this entry is the LOCKED build spec and the agent builds/tests against it exactly like Ludo.
details: Planned M1A game - no locked spec yet. Same proof-of-play contract + same M2 result seam as Ludo.
Lock the spec here (status -> locked) BEFORE building; the agent then uses this entry as the build + test benchmark.

modules.title: Universal result seam (the plug-and-play contract bus)
modules.summary: The single integration contract between every game and every reward module. One call per game finish, one subscription for all consumers. Standalone because it is the platform's wiring: 50 games = 1 reward plug, 1 competition plug.
details: Standalone module: it does NOT fit under game core (M1) or any reward module. It is the bus every game emits into and every consumer subscribes to.
Canonical envelope gfg:game-result@1: players[] with seat/actor (user|house|local)/position|score + optional on-chain proof. Implemented in public/universal/result-seam/game-result.js.
Every M1 game ends with one call: window.publishGameResult({gameId, players, proof}). The bus validates/normalizes, attaches wallet identity to 'user' seats, and fans the result out.
Consumers subscribe via window.onGameResult(handler) + a 'gfg:game-result' DOM event. M3/M4/M7 (local points, global ledgers, competitions) subscribe here and NEVER read game internals.
No game ships its own reward/competition plug. Adding a new game = emit the same envelope; the platform does not change.
Ludo (ludo-lab) now emits this envelope on match completion (replaces the ad-hoc onGfgMatchResult seam).

PHYSICAL HOME (universal/): every universal module lives under public/universal/ (result-seam/ = M2, points/ = M3, ledgers/ = M4, assets/ = M4 inventory wallet, subscription/ = M5, point-sources/ = M6, competitions/ = M7, escrow/ = M8). A game plugs in ONCE (window.publishGameResult); a universal module subscribes ONCE (window.onGameResult) and updates inside its own folder without ever touching a game. UNIVERSAL MEANS REUSABLE BY NAME: a universal module is game-agnostic - any M1 game (Ludo, Ayo Olopon, ...) plugs into it and reuses it; it is NEVER tailored to one game the way M1 game code is.

modules.title: Local points (per game, PURE + SPENDABLE, on-chain via ER)
modules.summary: Two on-chain local ledgers per game per player, both gasless on the MagicBlock ER: (1) LOCAL PURE (unspendable lifetime): every verified win point ever earned in that game, never diluted, never spent - the native-gamer bragging-rights source of truth; (2) LOCAL SPENDABLE: the spendable split of that same game's earned points, drawn down only by that game's own in-game spends (future shop), never a bragging-rights number. Only the signed-in 'You' seat ever earns; computers and non-You humans earn nothing regardless of position.
details: BUILD ORDER: M3 is the FIRST universal consumer of the result seam (M2) - it proves the bus end-to-end. Build after M1 (Ludo complete) + M2 (seam live). D1/D2/D3 owner-locked 2026-08-16.

TWO-TRACK DESIGN (owner decision 2026-08-16): mirrors the global M4 lifetime/spendable split but PER GAME. Track 1 LOCAL PURE = cumulative lifetime won points in that game, unspendable, undiluted (no purchase/referral/giveaway/multiplier ever here) - source of truth for native-game competency. Track 2 LOCAL SPENDABLE = the spendable split of the same wins (credited together with pure on a verified win), decremented ONLY by that game's own in-game purchases/items (S3 shop), goes up and down, never a bragging-rights number. ONE PDA holds both tracks so one account = one delegation = one onboarding fee.

PROGRAM DECISION (owner-approved, MagicBlock-researched 2026-08-16): NO new program - EXTEND the existing delegated gfg program (it is game-agnostic: game_tag is data, not code). Rationale: MagicBlock public ER nodes are gasless (tx fee 0; only session 0.0003 SOL at undelegation + commit 0.0001 SOL are paid by the sponsor/delegator, never the user). One delegated program = ONE ER session per player = ONE onboarding fee (init+delegate ~0.0086 SOL for dice+points+result), every record_points / spend_local after that is FREE. A second program would force a second delegation + second onboarding per player per game - unsustainable for 50+ games. Modularity lives in the M3 universal module (public/universal/points/) + game_tag seeds, NOT a new program.

SEEDS (D2 locked): PlayerPoints PDA = [gfgpoints, game_tag, player_authority]. game_tag ('ludo', 'ayo_olopon') isolates each game's ledger; 50+ games each get their own. D2 originally said old untagged gfgpoints PDAs (pre-module Scope B) 'become stale - wipable, no migration' - SHIPPED STRONGER (2026-08-16): the program gained a permissionless, idempotent migrate_points instruction that copies the legacy [gfgpoints, player] account (old total_points layout) into the per-game [gfgpoints, game_tag, player] ledger as BOTH tracks (1:1 split), so no lifetime points are lost across the seed change; the legacy account is left as a tombstone (never closed). All tracked devnet players migrated live. Enforced by .opencode/rules/solana-upgrade-safety.md.

ACCOUNT (PlayerPoints rework, shipped): fields local_pure_lifetime (u64), local_spendable_balance (u64), last_points, last_reason, last_match_ref (first 8 bytes of the proof-roll sig as u64), last_recorded_ts, award_count, last_spend_ts, last_spend_ref, last_spend_reason, spend_count. game_tag is IN THE SEED, not stored (a re-tag would orphan the ledger). local_ prefix reserved so M4 globals can add global_* later.

INSTRUCTIONS (same program id, deployed 2026-08-16, 22 instructions): initialize_points(game_tag), delegate_points(game_tag) (seed [gfgpoints, game_tag, authority]), record_points(game_tag, points, reason, match_ref) - credits local_pure_lifetime AND local_spendable_balance together on a verified win + duplicate-match_ref guard, NEW spend_local(game_tag, amount, reason, spend_ref) - decrements local_spendable_balance ONLY (pure untouched), InsufficientBalance guard, runs gasless on ER (session key signs, 0 SOL), NEW migrate_points(game_tag) - permissionless base-layer data-preservation migration (see SEEDS above).

RELAY: scripts/delegate-relay.mjs handleDelegate(player, gameTag='ludo') creates + delegates the tagged points PDA alongside dice + result PDAs in one idempotent call; handleMigratePoints(player, gameTag) runs the on-chain migration (sponsor pays); POST /api/delegate accepts gameTag, POST /api/migrate-points runs the migration; spend ledger + caps unchanged.

CLIENT (src/magicblock-vrf.js): recordPoints(gameTag, points, reason, matchRef) [wrapper also accepts legacy (points, reason, matchRef) -> gameTag 'ludo'], fetchPointsPda(gameTag) reads both tracks + spend audit, NEW spendLocal(gameTag, amount, reason, spendRef), claimComp(compPda, winnerIndex, gameTag), SPEND_REASONS exposed on window.

SCORING TABLE (D1 locked, Ludo - lives in the M3 module config, NOT the game; M1 never knows points rules): 4P mode -> 1st=100, 2nd=50, 3rd=10, 4th=0 (the game auto-ends once 3 winners emerge - the last seat cannot play against itself, so 4th earns nothing); 2P mode -> 1st=100 only (2P auto-ends the moment 1st emerges, so 2nd earns nothing). Graduated 4P rewards are a retention device: 'You' keeps playing for 50/10 even if not 1st. ONLY the 'You' (actor 'user') seat earns, at its own finishing position; house ('house') and local-human ('local') seats earn NOTHING even if they finish 1st. Mode derived from the envelope's players[] length (2 vs 4) - no M2 envelope change needed.

GATING: envelope.proof.signature (valid on-chain proof roll) required to bank; match_ref = first 8 bytes of that signature. IDEMPOTENT by match_ref: the module keeps a processed-match_ref set (in-memory + localStorage) so a reload or duplicate seam event never double-banks; the program guards via last_match_ref too.

NO DILUTION (hard rule): local pure NEVER receives signup bonus, purchases, referral, giveaways, Active Tier multiplier - those are M6 -> M4 only. spendable_balance only ever moves from verified local wins (credit) and that game's own spends (debit).

MODULE (public/universal/points/, game-agnostic - ANY M1 game plugs in): subscribes window.onGameResult once, computes the award from its per-game scoring config, banks via recordPoints(gameTag), exposes window.localPoints { get(gameTag) -> {pure, spendable}, spend(gameTag, amount, reason, ref), subscribe(cb) }, and fills DOM slots data-local-points-pure / data-local-points-spendable on any game page. A new game = add its scoring table to the module config + emit the seam; no game-side reward code.
ludo-lab UI: hosts the local-points display slot on the game page (pure + spendable). The game ships NO reward code (already clean: win-detection only emits the seam + Scope C result).

LEGACY (D3 locked): public/games/ludo/ is NOT touched at all - all module work targets ludo-lab only. Its pre-module record_points call (old signature) will soft-fail silently after the rework - accepted.

RECOVERY: Supabase backup is a LATER step (devnet-wipe recovery) - the on-chain records carry enough (game_tag, reason, match_ref, points) to rebuild both tracks; spend events are replayable too. Not built in the first M3 pass; tracked in the M3 build item.

TEST (benchmark = this spec): M3 module harness - simulated envelopes for 2P/4P x user 1st..4th x house/local seats -> exact award (100/50/10/0, user-only), idempotency on duplicate match_ref, spend_local decrements spendable only; on-chain ER harness (er-test pattern) - gasless record_points + spend_local on a tagged PDA from a 0-SOL session key.

[2026-08-16 hardening+display]: intermediate pre-deploy build zeroed legacy ledgers during migrate_points (read-before-write); root cause FIXED in current deployed build (read legacy fully, copy 1:1 to tagged, tombstone), ELF-verified, re-verified no-op on restored ledgers. Restore tool scripts/restore-points.mjs (explicit + --from-supabase) restores wiped/zeroed ledgers (used to restore 3 orphaned legacy accounts 400/200/5000, verified on-chain, idempotent skip-guard). Harnesses: er-points-harness.mjs PASS (gasless record_points+spend_local 0-SOL player, spendable-only decrement) + m3-module-harness.mjs 29/29 (locked scoring, user-only, idempotency, spend, resilience: retry-on-transient, confirm-timeout ledger read-back recovery, hard-failure surfacing). Display wired: module exposes lastAward + (gameTag,ledger,award) notify + re-fetch on gfg:auth-changed; global header chip via initGlobalHeader({localPointsTag}); client pointsPda(gameTag) powers the profile on-chain ledger card.

[2026-08-16 live verify + resilience]: owner re-tested the 2P win live on mobile and the +100 banked; on-chain crosscheck of the test wallet (FBWcuv...VnbCN) confirms the ludo points PDA (7aGs8riYmxQsMy1jiaGavw7Rnx6pb8gFwmC9VH4RfHDB) holds pure=100 spendable=100 award_count=1 reason=WIN_1ST bound to the proof-roll match_ref (0x136f6555f6). The root cause of the earlier silent no-show was browser-path error-swallowing (the on-chain write path itself was proven by scripts/browser-path-repro.mjs, a 0-SOL player as ER fee payer). Bank is now resilient + observable: 3x retry (idempotent via the program's DuplicateMatchRef guard), confirm-timeout recovered by re-reading the ledger, failed state surfaced via lastError + a status:'failed' notification. CEREMONY NEVER-PROMISE RULE: the ludo-lab ceremony shows '+N points loading... don't refresh the page' while the write is in flight and a neutral no-amount pending line on failure; the definitive '+N banked on-chain' appears ONLY once the write is confirmed. clearTransient() resets the award/error state on Play Again. Browser write path kept as scripts/browser-path-repro.mjs regression proof.

modules.title: Global points (3 ledgers) + on-chain inventory wallet (site-wide, decoupled from gameplay)
modules.summary: M4a Global Pure (sum of M3 local wins across all games, no multiplier, honest cross-game skill total). M4b Global Lifetime (unspendable) - every point ever earned from any source. M4c Global Spendable - the spendable split of lifetime. The 2x/3x/4x multiplier applies ONLY at M4 flow-up, never on M3 or M4a. M4 ALSO owns the player's on-chain inventory/asset wallet ([gfgassets, player]): skins/items/sounds living IN the account (media bytes on-chain), the embedded wallet owns, the platform frontend views the chain bytes directly - 'the wallet is a viewer'.
details: M4a GLOBAL PURE: strictly the sum of M3 local wins across all games. No multiplier, no purchases, no bonus. The honest 'how good are you across the whole platform' number.
M4b GLOBAL LIFETIME (unspendable): every point ever earned from ANY source (game wins, signup bonus, giveaways, referral, sub multiplier). Permanent reputation/level number.
M4c GLOBAL SPENDABLE: the spendable split of lifetime. Purchases, Active Tier buys, comp entries, cosmetics all flow here. Goes up and down.
Active Tier 2x/3x/4x multiplier applies ONLY at M4 flow-up (lifetime + spendable), NEVER on M3 local or M4a pure.
Source-tagged: every M4 credit carries its game/event source ('Ludo', 'Ayo Olopon', 'signup_bonus', 'referral', 'giveaway').

ON-CHAIN (owner-locked 2026-08-16): the 3 global ledgers live on-chain via the SAME delegated gfg program, NOT in Supabase. Reuse the M3 decision: one delegated program = one ER session per player = one onboarding fee; every record_global / spend_global is gasless on the ER (session key signs, 0 fees). No new program.

SEED (fits the existing per-game scheme, game_tag is data not code): GlobalPoints PDA = [gfgpoints, 'global', player_authority] - the reserved 'global' tag, documented so no future game uses it. NEW separate account type (GlobalPoints layout: global_pure_lifetime, global_lifetime, global_spendable_balance, last_source, last_points, last_reason, last_match_ref, last_recorded_ts, award_count, last_spend_*, spend_count) - do NOT extend the PlayerPoints layout (upgrade-safety R2: layouts are versioned; a separate account avoids touching the live M3 schema). No migration needed: the old single global_points/lifetime_points was Supabase-only, there is no legacy on-chain global account.

INSTRUCTIONS (same program id, new capability): initialize_global_points, delegate_global_points (seed [gfgpoints, 'global', authority]), record_global_points(kind u8, source_tag, points, reason, match_ref) where kind 0 = GAME WIN (credits M4a pure + M4b lifetime + M4c spendable) and kind 1 = OTHER credit (signup_bonus/referral/giveaway - credits M4b + M4c ONLY, never M4a pure), duplicate match_ref guard; spend_global(amount, reason, spend_ref) decrements M4c spendable ONLY (M4a/M4b untouched), InsufficientBalance guard, idempotent spend_ref. All gasless on the ER.

FLOW-UP CONTRACT (multiplier-blind M4 - best option): M4 does NOT know tiers. The Active Tier 2x/3x/4x multiplier lives in M5 and is applied as a SECOND, distinct credit through the same API: M4 subscribes to the seam and banks the BASE unmultiplied win into M4a+M4b+M4c; M5's tier driver then records the boost as its own credit (source_tag e.g. 'tier2_boost', kind 1, points = (multiplier-1)*base) into M4b+M4c only. M4a pure therefore can NEVER be multiplied, by construction. Both writes are gasless; both idempotent by match_ref.

MODULE (public/universal/ledgers/, game-agnostic): subscribes window.onGameResult once for the base win credit; exposes window.globalLedger = { get() -> {pure, lifetime, spendable}, credit({source, kind, points, matchRef}), spend(amount, reason, ref), subscribe(cb) } so M5/M6/M7 drive boosts/credits/spends through one API. Mirror of the M3 module patterns (retry, confirm-timeout read-back recovery, never-promise display).
SUPABASE ROLE (owner decision 2026-08-16): backup/restore ONLY for devnet-wipe recovery before mainnet (same recovery model as M3's restore tool). It is never the live source of truth for any ledger.
Current state to change: today there is ONE global_points + lifetime_points on the profile and a single point_transactions ledger; this becomes the 3-ledger M4 model.
ORDERING: M4 consumes the result seam (M2) so it must be live before M5 money work - build after M3 is stable/verified for Ludo, before M5. Already the build order (M1+M2+M3 -> M4 -> M5).

ON-CHAIN INVENTORY + ASSETS (owner-locked 2026-08-17, feasibility MagicBlock-researched): the player's on-chain item wallet - skins, cosmetics, items, sounds. The 'wallet is a viewer' model: the account IS the source of truth for BOTH ownership and (by default) the media bytes; the embedded wallet owns it, the platform frontend reads the account and renders the media directly (open the on-chain image/sound and see it, no external host in the path). Feasibility proven by MagicBlock docs + samples: the ER executes any Solana account model gasless (ER lifecycle: tx fee 0, ~50ms slots, ~100ms confirm; pricing: base 0 per tx, 0.0003 SOL per ER session at undelegation, 0.0001 SOL per commit, VRF on ER free); Solana Generals generates its map via an ER transaction (fully on-chain game, 100% serverless); Magic UNO deals/plays/draws every card on-chain gasless with VRF shuffles; Session Keys are the documented pattern for 'in-app NFTs purchase' (scoped, time-limited, gasless); the MagicBlock Asset Manager SDK ships exactly this storage pattern - 'store assets (images, animations, sounds, JSON metadata) directly in an Assets account on the ER' (base64 compression, IPFS optional, DApp loads assets directly from the ER). No new program - same delegated gfg program, one ER session per player, every grant/equip gasless.

ASSET ACCOUNT (PlayerAssets): PDA [gfgassets, player_authority], NEW seed prefix gfgassets (immutable, upgrade-safety R1), site-wide (a skin owned once is owned across games; per-game scoping is an entry field, NOT the seed). Layout versioned from day one (R2): version u8, item_count u16, entries[] {asset_id u64, game_tag [u8;16], media_type u8 (png/webp/ogg/mp3/json), w u16, h u16, byte_len u32, data_offset u32, state u8 (owned/equipped/revoked), unlock_ts i64} + a media blob region holding the raw bytes (base64/compressed). Reads use getAccountInfo dataSlice so the profile fetches only one asset's byte range, never the whole account (read latency stays low regardless of account size).

MEDIA-IN-ACCOUNT POLICY (owner decision): item media bytes live IN the account by default (the viewer opens the on-chain bytes directly - no IPFS/CDN simplification). Large full-res blobs (> ~128KB) become entry references (URL/CID) with ownership + entitlement still on-chain. Devnet = $0 at any size (faucet); mainnet cost = rent-exempt 0.00000696 SOL/byte (refundable if the account closes) + sponsor-absorbed session/commit micro-costs - so keep per-asset media lean and defer the size call until user counts are real. The account model is identical either way: zero rebuild, this is the mainnet-ready answer.

INSTRUCTIONS (same program id, new capability, all gasless on the ER via the player's session key): initialize_assets, delegate_assets (seed [gfgassets, authority]), grant_asset(asset_id, media_type, w, h, data) - atomically writes an entry + its media bytes, update_asset_state(asset_id, state) - equip/unequip/revoke, add_asset_media(asset_id, offset, chunk) - chunked write for larger blobs. Ownership is program-enforced: only the account authority (session key) mutates.

MODULE (public/universal/assets/, game-agnostic, part of M4): window.gfgAssets = { list() -> owned items, open(assetId) -> {mediaType, blobUrl} (reads the account bytes with a sliced read, decodes, returns an object URL the UI renders in /

modules.title: Monthly subscription (powers the multiplier)
modules.summary: The consistent-money module: a monthly subscription (Active Tier) bought from spendable points that powers the 2x/3x/4x win multiplier applied at M4 flow-up. The core recurring revenue stream.
details: Standalone module because it is the consistent money engine: 1,000 / 2,500 / 5,000 spendable per month for 2x / 3x / 4x (econ-003 settled ladder).
Multiplier applies ONLY at M4 flow-up (lifetime + spendable), never on M3 local or M4a pure. A player's pure local wins stay honest.
Build timing: EARLY, immediately after the game (M1-M4) - the platform can't launch without the monthly subscription because players expect to upgrade and get a multiplier instead of base rewards.
Future: real-money subscription once payment rails mature (econ-006 stream 3).
Gates M7 competition entry in the settled design.

modules.title: Point-source modules (referral, giveaway, signup, social earn)
modules.summary: The other point sources that feed M4 (lifetime + spendable) but NEVER M3 local. Signup bonus from day 1; referral, giveaway and social-share earn paths built early.
details: SIGNUP BONUS: from day 1 a user joins the platform. Goes to M4c spendable (and M4b lifetime), NEVER M3 local, so bragging rights stay pure.
REFERRAL: invites earn the referrer M4 points when the friend joins/plays. Early build - core acquisition.
GIVEAWAY: promotional/lootbox-style surprises (econ-001), feed M4 only.
SOCIAL EARN: share-linked small earn paths to soften the buy-to-join moment (econ-005).
Rule: ALL of these feed M4 (lifetime + spendable), never M3 local and never M4a pure. M3 stays strictly verified gameplay.

modules.title: Competitions (standalone, game-agnostic)
modules.summary: Entry config = points requirement + optional custom fields (e.g. phone number for airtime). Plugs into one / multiple / all games. Pluggable payout: airtime, escrow, manual. Runs fine with NO sponsor.
details: Game-agnostic: a competition selects which games' points count (one, several, or all), never tailored to a single game.
Entry requirements: general (points threshold) + competition-specific custom fields (e.g. phone number for airtime rewards).
Payout is pluggable: airtime (via phone field), on-chain escrow (M8), or manual. Standalone even with no sponsor.
Product build is deferred until M1-M4 ship and test; the escrow program proof (M8) already exists on devnet.
NG test-launch plan: 1-2 week launch, daily airtime to winners via the phone number collected at entry.
Consumes the result seam (M2): subscribes to window.onGameResult for verified finishes.

modules.title: Sponsor escrow (optional plugin, separate from M7)
modules.summary: Brand-funded prize pool locked on-chain BEFORE the event, 30/70 rake at settle. A competition may use M8 or not. Optional plugin, not part of the core competition flow.
details: Program proof already built + verified on devnet (Competition account, fund/close/settle/claim, 70/30 winners bucket, one active comp per sponsor).
Sponsor (brand) locks SOL on-chain before the event; winners claim gasless; platform keeps 30%.
Kept SEPARATE from M7: a competition runs without M8 (airtime / manual payout). M8 is attached only when a brand wants a guaranteed escrowed prize.
Mainnet legal framing: points entry + small fee, prizes in points, real value only via escrow with T&Cs.

rules: M1 never calls M4: the game and rewards are separated. The game emits into the seam (M2) and knows nothing about how points work.

UNIVERSAL SEAM (M2) is the ONLY way out of a game: every game ends with the same call (window.publishGameResult, gfg:game-result@1 envelope). M3/M4/M7 subscribe to the bus (window.onGameResult) and never read game internals. No game ships its own reward/competition plug.
M7 needs no M8: competitions stand alone from sponsor; escrow is an optional plugin.
Local (M3) never diluted: no multiplier, no purchase, no bonus, no giveaway, no referral on local points.
Multiplier only at M4 flow-up: 2x/3x/4x touches M4b lifetime + M4c spendable, never M3 or M4a.
Everything slots together by source tag ('Ludo', 'Ayo Olopon', 'signup_bonus', 'referral').
Modular + pluggable: each module is interchangeable and game-agnostic; no module is tailored to a single game.

Extensible: M1-M8 cover the current roadmap. Any genuinely new domain (community/forum, support, profile, etc.) becomes a NEW module (M9+) recorded here FIRST. A feature is never 'unmodular' - it either slots into an existing module or earns a new one.

LOCKED PER-GAME SPECS ARE THE BENCHMARK (M1A rule): each game under M1A (Ludo locked, Ayo Olopon planned, ...) has its own LOCKED spec in the M1 game dropdown - the source of truth for building AND testing that game. The agent reads it before/during the build, checks the result against it, and only concludes/commits/pushes M1 for that game when the build matches A-Z.
implementationOrder: 1. M1 + M2 + M3 + M4 for Ludo: Ludo whole, testable now. Per-game local PDA (program tweak + redeploy), pure base writes, multiplier at M4 flow-up, 3 global ledgers. Test it.
2. M5 monthly subscription (after M1-M4): the money engine - Active Tier multiplier at flow-up, spendable drain.
3. M6 point sources: signup bonus (day 1), referral, giveaway, social earn.
4. M7 competitions game-agnostic (after M1-M4 stable), with pluggable payout (airtime / manual / escrow).
5. M8 sponsor escrow plugin (program proof already exists) - attached only when a brand wants an escrowed prize.
